'''Reswa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] from the planet [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]]. She was the [[hatchmate]] of famed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]] of the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi High Council]]. It is unknown whether she survived the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] devastation of Barab I during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
